reviewer_role: Separate semantic-case and protocol review agent; also authored the development_v2 contracts. Not an external or blind human review.

semantic_revalidation.execution: Every upstream snippet and external check ran through SandboxRunner; reference and negative candidates were recorded-candidate replay.

protocol_checks.test_command: EXAMPLEPROOF_SANDBOX_TESTS=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_semantic_study.py -v
protocol_checks.model_transport: Mocked HTTP responses only, on self-authored temporary fixtures; these are not live-model effect measurements.
covered: Actual first-request payloads are equal within the two legacy arms and within the three v2 arms.
Legacy arms use the original SYSTEM and legacy context; categorized information appears only in later feedback_v2 history.
External check text, expected-output text and private output sentinels are absent from model payloads.
Paired seeds, maximum generation budgets, first-success stopping, malformed generations and infrastructure failures retain their intended accounting.
Healthy controls make no model requests; selected candidates are replayed, patched and checked without counting extra live requests.
Input/context tampering stops the run before a model request.
Mislabeled or previously seen development data is rejected as holdout before model metadata is queried.
A missing, stale, rewritten or development-inapplicable method lock is rejected. A valid lock is embedded in the frozen design.

checks: All 999 indexed snippets were compared with their exact line slices in the archived CPython corpus.
Corpus SHA, every module SHA, embedded provenance and complete LICENSE text match the source archive records.
The index module contains literal data; source selection and index generation use AST/text processing without importing indexed or project modules.
A synthetic selected module containing a top-level RuntimeError was retrieved without host execution.
Fallback requires a missing-import error, a matching actual from-import in the original snippet, and the corresponding selected project module.
Evaluator-check errors are sanitized and do not activate missing-import fallback.
Synthetic limits 0, 1, 20, 80, 1000 and 6000 all respected the label-plus-text character budget.
Fallback divides the fixed budget into project and standard-library pools; unused allocation is not transferred.
The private-owner collision regression was independently reproduced, fixed by the implementation owner, and independently rerun successfully.

fixed_issue.description: Public.lookup() could also retrieve _Hidden.lookup because matching method names exempted an unrelated private owner from filtering.
fixed_issue.resolution: Private owners outside the inferred receiver roots are now rejected before method-name exemptions.
fixed_issue.independent_recheck: The synthetic Public/_Hidden example now returns the Public class and method only.

limits: Static lexical matches are suggestions, not proof that an API is the correct behavioral replacement.
The corpus excludes classes, subpackages and C builtins, and is not a complete standard-library API inventory.
Official CPython 3.10.12 source is version-aligned with the runner but is not claimed byte-identical to a distributor-patched interpreter.
Added standard-library information is part of the complete method change; improvements cannot be attributed solely to feedback.

semantic_blind_spots.covered: Ordinary, empty, Unicode and HTML-sensitive strings; str-subclass and Markup identity; numeric, boolean and None conversion; __str__ rather than __html__ behavior.
semantic_blind_spots.remaining: No exhaustive bytes/container conversion or __str__ exception-propagation checks; native Python fallback only, not the C extension. The retained original display regression still does not establish general conversion equivalence.

semantic_blind_spots.covered: Default/named table scope, preservation of unrelated tables, multiple and boundary-valued records, repeated operations, missing/empty table handling, recreation IDs, query results and closing/reopening JSON storage.
semantic_blind_spots.remaining: The default-table query is populated before a further insert, and insert already clears the query cache. Therefore the current sequence does not independently isolate cache invalidation by clear_default itself. Named-table cache/recreation behavior is still checked. Only single-instance JSONStorage is covered, without middleware or concurrent access.
semantic_blind_spots.evidence: Target tinydb/table.py _update_table calls self.clear_cache() after every write (line 773 in the pinned copy).
semantic_blind_spots.treatment: Do not change frozen development checks or rescore previous runs. In a future declared case version, populate the query cache after the final insertion before clearing.

semantic_blind_spots.covered: Duplicates, ascending stable equal-key order, key and reverse together, Unicode, empty and one-shot inputs, no consumption at construction, bounded prefix consumption and a finite prefix of infinite streams.
semantic_blind_spots.remaining: No explicit throwing-iterator behavior, descending equal-key stability, exhaustive custom comparisons or large-scale performance measurement.

interpretation: These checks strengthen finite behavioral evidence for deliberately selected development cases. They are not a general semantic-equivalence proof, a hostile-code integrity boundary, a blind correctness assessment or a heldout-model success rate. No development input was changed in response to the reviewed live results.
